title: Changelog, release-readiness verification, manifest commit, and the annotated v1.1.0 tag
notes: Documentation portion: docs/changelog.md gained the Phase 14 v1.1 release entry (version 1.1.0.0, tag v1.1.0, features, artifact identity 594,931 bytes / SHA-256 85730fe7... / MD5 547beb2f... / 7 entries, the four suite counts, the task 14.3 live matrix result, and the task 14.4 security outcome with accepted limitations SEC-10/SEC-11/SEC-12); docs/project-status.md was reconciled to the 1.1.0.0/v1.1.0 current state (Phase 8 1.0.1.0 preserved as history); docs/architecture.md and docs/implementation-readiness.md status lines were reconciled and their Phase 8 text marked historical; the SEC-14.4-03 stale pre-logging 'zero logging call sites' current-state line in docs/planning/v1.1.md was framed as planning-time and superseded by Phase 10; PLANS.md task 14.5 and its Project Status paragraph/Milestone Status row were updated. manifest.json was verified current and was not modified (already committed at 2b0351c).

Release-reviewer gate: docs/implementation/final-review/release-review.json is reviewer_status APPROVED_WITH_ACCEPTED_LIMITATIONS, release_decision SHIP_WITH_ACCEPTED_LIMITATIONS, open_blocker_high 0. The prior 1.0.1.0 release review was preserved as release-review.1.0.1.json. The reviewer independently reproduced the artifact byte-identically from a clean git-archive export, re-ran the full test matrix (default 1491/66/1557 clean-export and 1494/63/1557 with the artifact, host-guarded 1513/44/1557, forced-native 1575/20/1595, all Failed 0), confirmed the Phases 9-13 phase reviews/tags, the security review (0 open BLOCKER/HIGH), the live matrix (all 8 rows PASS), and re-ran the live path itself on the pinned host.

Accepted limitations added to docs/limitations.md by the release reviewer: P12R-F1 (MEDIUM, default-fingerprint pin only in the forced-native golden path), V11-G1 (LOW, Goal B allowlist not live-exercised), V11-G2 (LOW, Phase 9-13 residuals), V11-G3 (LOW, carried 1.0.1.0-audit LOWs), and V11-G4 (LOW, stale pre-14.3 'owned by task 14.3' pending phrasing), alongside the V1 and security residuals.

The release tag v1.1.0 is created by the orchestrator at the Phase 14 closure commit, after this gate and with explicit user approval. Docs/changelog.md and docs/project-status.md remain the user's named publish surfaces; the push, GitHub release, and asset upload remain the user's manual step.
The implementation-worker ran at variant high; the release-reviewer ran at variant max. The orchestrator recorded the runtime-reported model/variant for each session.
Runtime figures are authoritative from the OpenCode session usage endpoint (.opencode/scripts/collect-session-usage.sh); no values were estimated.
